metadata.title: Neo4j Kubernetes Operator on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
metadata.description: Deploys an Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster and provisions the Neo4j Kubernetes Operator with an optional Neo4j database instance.
metadata.author: Neo4j Partners

metadata.description: The name of the Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster.
The Azure region where resources will be deployed.
The version of Kubernetes to use for the AKS cluster.
The virtual machine size for the AKS worker nodes.
The number of nodes in the AKS system node pool.
OS disk size in GB for each AKS node.
The release version of the Neo4j Kubernetes Operator to install.
The Kubernetes namespace to deploy the Neo4j Operator into.
Whether to automatically deploy an initial Neo4j database instance.
The metadata name for the Neo4j Custom Resource.
Acknowledge and accept the Neo4j Enterprise Edition license agreement.
Database topology mode: Standalone or Cluster (Enterprise only).
Number of core cluster servers if Topology Mode is Cluster.
Persistent storage volume size for Neo4j database data (e.g. 20Gi, 50Gi).
Optional initial password for neo4j user. If empty, operator generates a random secret.
Kubernetes service type for external or internal database access.

properties.scriptContent:
set -euo pipefail
echo "Connecting to AKS cluster..."
MAX_RETRIES=15
CONNECTED=false
for ((i=1; i<=MAX_RETRIES; i++)); do
  echo "Attempt $i to fetch credentials..."
  if az aks get-credentials --resource-group "${RESOURCE_GROUP}" --name "${CLUSTER_NAME}" --admin --overwrite-existing 2>/dev/null; then
    if kubectl get nodes --request-timeout='10s' &>/dev/null; then
      CONNECTED=true
      break
    fi
  fi
  sleep 10
done

if [[ "${CONNECTED}" != "true" ]]; then
  echo "Failed to connect to AKS cluster." >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "Applying Neo4j CRDs..."
CRD_URL="https://github.com/neo4j-partners/neo4j-kubernetes-operator/releases/download/v${OPERATOR_VERSION}/neo4j-crd-${OPERATOR_VERSION}.yaml"
kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts -f "${CRD_URL}" || true

echo "Installing Neo4j Operator via Helm (OCI)..."
helm upgrade --install neo4j-operator oci://ghcr.io/neo4j-partners/charts/neo4j-operator \
  --version "${OPERATOR_VERSION}" \
  --namespace "${OPERATOR_NAMESPACE}" \
  --create-namespace \
  --wait \
  --timeout 10m

DATABASE_ENDPOINT="N/A"
BOLT_ENDPOINT="N/A"
HTTP_ENDPOINT="N/A"

if [[ "${DEPLOY_INSTANCE}" == "true" ]]; then
  echo "Deploying Neo4j Custom Resource..."
  APP_NAMESPACE="default"
  if [[ -n "${NEO4J_PASSWORD}" ]]; then
    kubectl create secret generic "${INSTANCE_NAME}-auth" \
      --namespace "${APP_NAMESPACE}" \
      --from-literal=NEO4J_AUTH="neo4j/${NEO4J_PASSWORD}" \
      --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
  fi

  TOPOLOGY_CONFIG="mode: Standalone"
  if [[ "${TOPOLOGY_MODE}" == "Cluster" && "${NEO4J_EDITION}" == "enterprise" ]]; then
    TOPOLOGY_CONFIG="mode: Cluster
    cluster:
      core:
        servers: ${CLUSTER_CORE_COUNT}"
  fi

  LICENSE_CONFIG=""
  if [[ "${NEO4J_EDITION}" == "enterprise" ]]; then
    LICENSE_CONFIG="license:
    accept: \"${ACCEPT_LICENSE}\""
  fi

  cat <<EOF > /tmp/neo4j-cr.yaml
apiVersion: neo4j.com/v1
kind: Neo4j
metadata:
  name: ${INSTANCE_NAME}
  namespace: ${APP_NAMESPACE}
spec:
  edition: ${NEO4J_EDITION}
  version: "${NEO4J_VERSION}"
  ${LICENSE_CONFIG}
  topology:
    ${TOPOLOGY_CONFIG}
  storage:
    volumes:
      data:
        mode: Dynamic
        dynamic:
          size: "${STORAGE_SIZE}"
  networking:
    services:
      default:
        type: ${SERVICE_TYPE}
EOF
  kubectl apply -f /tmp/neo4j-cr.yaml
  sleep 15

  if [[ "${SERVICE_TYPE}" == "LoadBalancer" ]]; then
    for ((j=1; j<=30; j++)); do
      SERVICE_IP=$(kubectl get svc -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" -l "app.kubernetes.io/instance=${INSTANCE_NAME}" -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].ip}' 2>/dev/null || true)
      if [[ -z "${SERVICE_IP}" ]]; then
        SERVICE_IP=$(kubectl get svc -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" -l "neo4j.com/instance=${INSTANCE_NAME}" -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].ip}' 2>/dev/null || true)
      fi
      if [[ -n "${SERVICE_IP}" ]]; then
        DATABASE_ENDPOINT="${SERVICE_IP}"
        BOLT_ENDPOINT="bolt://${SERVICE_IP}:7687"
        HTTP_ENDPOINT="http://${SERVICE_IP}:7474"
        break
      fi
      sleep 10
    done
  fi

  if [[ "${BOLT_ENDPOINT}" == "N/A" ]]; then
    DATABASE_ENDPOINT="${INSTANCE_NAME}.${APP_NAMESPACE}.svc.cluster.local"
    BOLT_ENDPOINT="bolt://${INSTANCE_NAME}.${APP_NAMESPACE}.svc.cluster.local:7687"
    HTTP_ENDPOINT="http://${INSTANCE_NAME}.${APP_NAMESPACE}.svc.cluster.local:7474"
  fi
fi

mkdir -p "$(dirname "${AZ_SCRIPTS_OUTPUT_PATH}")"
cat <<EOF > "${AZ_SCRIPTS_OUTPUT_PATH}"
{
  "status": "Success",
  "operatorNamespace": "${OPERATOR_NAMESPACE}",
  "operatorVersion": "${OPERATOR_VERSION}",
  "databaseEndpoint": "${DATABASE_ENDPOINT}",
  "boltEndpoint": "${BOLT_ENDPOINT}",
  "httpEndpoint": "${HTTP_ENDPOINT}",
  "clusterName": "${CLUSTER_NAME}"
}
EOF
